test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 13 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A is the sister of B and C. D is the father of C. E is the mother of A. Considering these facts, which of the following statements CANNOT be verified?

options.text: E is the mother of B.
D is the father of A.

solution: Preparing the family tree using the following symbols, [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cdd0b30cffaf954e65ff899730e11e9e4ceb2b8a3106f0f1cf7dc6cc2718c84.png] We can dram following Family Tree from the information given above: 1) A is the sister of B and C. 2) D is the father of C. 3) E is the mother of A.
